'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Erik Collazo LS Podrace Prep''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Erik Collazo]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Podrace Prep|Tat-L-podraceprep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Soul Harvester
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
